title: Stuffed Dolmades Recipe
description: A traditional Middle Eastern dish of grape leaves stuffed with a mixture of rice, meat, and spices.
instructions: Rinse the grape leaves and remove the stems.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked rice, ground beef, chopped onion, chopped parsley, salt, black pepper, and allspice.
Lay a grape leaf flat on a work surface, with the stem end facing you.
Place about 1 tablespoon of the rice mixture in the center of the grape leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a neat package.
Repeat with the remaining grape leaves and filling.
Place the dolmades seam-side down in a steamer basket and steam for 20-25 minutes, or until the grape leaves are tender.
Serve warm with a squeeze of lemon juice.
